name: crw-shield
author: Mathi5
short_desc: Firecrawl v2-compatible scraper with anti-bot bypass (TLS fingerprint + behavior timing).
description: crw-shield is a Rust HTTP scraper implementing the Firecrawl v2 API surface (/v2/scrape, /v2/crawl) with multi-layer anti-bot bypass: TLS ClientHello fingerprinting via wreq/BoringSSL, behaviour-aware timing jitter, L0–L3 profile rotation, opt-in FlareSolverr escalation, and a HITL fallback endpoint for human-in-the-loop challenge solving. Exposes a single binary on port 3002 with optional Docker Chromium for JS-heavy sites.

form_fields.label: Auth token (bearer)
form_fields.hint: Required bearer token for /v2/scrape and /v2/crawl. Leave blank to disable auth (NOT recommended in production).

form_fields.label: SearXNG URL
form_fields.hint: SearXNG instance used by the /v2/search endpoint. Leave blank to disable search (returns empty results with a warning).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a valid http(s) URL with optional port

form_fields.label: SearXNG token (optional)
form_fields.hint: Bearer token if your SearXNG instance has --server.request-method restrictions. Leave blank if SearXNG is publicly accessible on the network.

form_fields.label: FlareSolverr URL
form_fields.hint: FlareSolverr endpoint used to escalate Cloudflare IUAM, PerimeterX, Kasada and DataDome challenges. Leave blank to disable FS (L0–L3 only).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a valid http(s) URL with optional port

form_fields.label: FlareSolverr allowlist (comma-separated hosts)
form_fields.hint: Hosts to escalate to FlareSolverr. Supports *.example.com wildcards. Apex entries also match subdomains. Leave blank to disable FS.

form_fields.label: Enable TLS-impersonation proxy (Phase 1)
form_fields.hint: Spawns a Go sidecar (bogdanfinn/tls-client) routing Chrome's HTTPS through byte-perfect browser TLS ClientHellos. Off by default.

form_fields.label: Rate limit min interval (ms)
form_fields.hint: Minimum delay between consecutive scrapes (per host). 0 disables rate limiting. Match cortex-bridge defaults (2000ms) in production.

form_fields.label: Rate limit jitter (ms)
form_fields.hint: Random jitter added to the min interval. 0 disables jitter. Recommended ≤ 500ms to avoid 20-30s extra wait on 9-site panels.
